title: 第5章 嬴政 退朝我要招待仙师第6章 江辰 我是该叫你赵高还是叫你高要
slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: “好，既然如此就请师叔立下大道誓言吧。”
镇元子也不含糊:“大道在上，今日我镇元子在此立誓，在成圣之后定会尽心助师侄阻拦西方二圣，如违此誓，叫我终身无缘大道！”
江辰见镇元子已经立誓，留下了一块记载成圣法门的玉简就带着红孩儿离开了五庄观。
一路驾云朝着车迟国而去。
回到道观，江辰拿出一颗人参果指了指偏殿:“徒儿，以后你便在后面的大殿修行，这颗人参果你也拿去炼化了吧。”
“是，师尊。”
春去秋来，这天江辰正在观内静颂皇庭，门外来了三只小妖过来拜师，江辰神识扫过，正是西游里车迟国的三个国师。
此三妖本是山野精怪，却一心向道，苦修法术，虽无名师指点，却也修出了一身不弱的神通，在车迟国深受国王与百姓信奉。
当然了，也有一种说法是这三只小妖是被太白金星给忽悠过来的。
不过这些都不重要，江辰挥手在道观外立下两座大阵，然后开口说道:“道不可轻传，闯过大阵自有源法。”
三妖听了江辰的话也不犹豫，一头就扎进了大阵。
三天……五天……十天……
终于在第十天的时候三妖闯过了大阵，这让红孩儿有些懵逼:“师尊，他们三人明明根脚修为都不如我，为何闯阵速度会比我快?”
“那是我给他们三人降了一些难度，否则就算再给他们一月时间也闯不过我这大阵。”
“此三妖心性尚可，我欲收为外门弟子，留在车迟国，日后自有用处。”
正在此时三妖走进大殿，对着江辰就跪了下来:“弟子（虎力、鹿力、羊力）见过师尊。”
江辰端坐主位，目光扫过三妖：“尔等既闯过阵法，便算入我门墙，可为我外门弟子。”
“本座江辰，为通天圣人第二亲传，这是你们的内门师兄红孩儿。”
说着他抬手一挥，三道灵光分别落入三妖眉心：“这是我上清一脉外门弟子所修仙法，从今往后尔等需勤修苦练，万不可堕了我截教威名。”
三妖又惊又喜，连连叩首：“弟子遵命！定不负师尊教导！”
江辰想了想左手一翻，拿出了三件三件后天灵宝。
一柄寒光凛冽的断岳刀，一面能攻能守的八卦镜，还有一支操控雷电的五雷令。
虽只是后天灵宝，却也被他以混元道韵温养过，威力远超同级，如今正好赐给三妖用来防身。
江辰一挥手三件后天灵宝就飘到了三妖面前:“此三宝赐你等防身，现在都随你们师兄下去修炼吧，五百年内给我突破到大罗。”
“是，师尊。”
几人应声退下，对江辰的话不敢有任何反驳。
出了主殿，羊力忍不住朝着红孩儿问道:“师兄，我等资质师尊让我等五百年内突破到大罗是否有些……”
红孩儿笑着接话:“有些强人所难了是吧？”
“正是。”
“师尊可是混元大罗的强者，他的手段又岂是你能想到的？”
“实话告诉你吧，师尊功参造化，以无上大法力开辟了一个小世界，那方小世界灵气充足，且没有天道压制，时间流速只是洪荒的数万分之一，五百年成就大罗简直就跟吃饭喝水一样简单。”
content_en:
"Okay, in that case, let me ask my uncle to take the oath of greatness."
Zhen Yuanzi was also unambiguous: "The Great Dao is supreme. Today, I, Zhen Yuanzi, swear here that after becoming a saint, I will do my best to help my nephew stop the Second Saint of the West. If I violate this oath, I will never have access to the Great Dao!"
Jiang Chen saw that Zhen Yuanzi had made an oath and left behind a jade slip recording the method of becoming a saint, so he took Honghai'er and left Wuzhuang Temple.
Riding the clouds all the way towards Chechi Country.
Returning to the Taoist temple, Jiang Chen took out a ginseng fruit and pointed it at the side hall: "Disciple, from now on you will practice in the main hall at the back. You should also take this ginseng fruit and refine it."
"Yes, Master."
…
Spring has passed and autumn has come. On this day, Jiang Chen was quietly chanting in the imperial court. Three little demons came outside to pay homage to his disciples. Jiang Chen's spiritual consciousness scanned them, and they were the three national masters from the Chechi Kingdom in Journey to the West.
These three monsters were originally wild spirits, but they devoted themselves to Taoism and practiced magic. Although they were not taught by famous teachers, they also developed powerful magical powers and were deeply trusted by the king and people of Chechi Kingdom.
Of course, there is also a theory that these three little demons were fooled by Taibai Jinxing.
But these are not important. Jiang Chen waved his hand and set up two large formations outside the Taoist temple, and then said: "The Tao cannot be taught lightly. Breaking through the large formations will have its own original method."
The three demons didn't hesitate after hearing Jiang Chen's words and plunged into the formation.
Three days...five days...ten days...
Finally, on the tenth day, the three demons broke through the formation, which made Hong Boy a little confused: "Master, the three of them are obviously not as good as me in terms of basic skills, so why can they break through the formation faster than me?"
"That's because I have lowered the difficulty for the three of them. Otherwise, even if I give them another month, they won't be able to break through my formation."
"These three demons are of good character. I would like to accept them as outer disciples and stay in Chechi Country. They will be useful in the future."
At this time, the three demons walked into the hall and knelt down facing Jiang Chen: "Disciples (Hu Li, Lu Li, and Yang Li) have met Master."
Jiang Chen sat on the main seat and glanced at the three demons: "Since you have broken through the formation, you can be considered as my outer disciples."
"I, Jiang Chen, am the second direct descendant of Saint Tongtian. This is your inner sect brother Hong Hai'er."
As he spoke, he raised his hand and waved, and three rays of spiritual light fell into the eyebrows of the three monsters respectively: "This is the immortal method practiced by my outer disciples of the Shangqing lineage. From now on, you must practice diligently and hard, and you must not lose the reputation of my interception sect."
The three demons were surprised and happy, and kowtowed repeatedly: "Disciple, obey your orders! You will definitely live up to your master's teachings!"
Jiang Chen thought for a while, turned his left hand, and took out three acquired spiritual treasures.
A cold-light Duanyue Sword, a Bagua Mirror that can attack and defend, and a Five Thunder Order that controls thunder and lightning.
Although it was only an acquired spiritual treasure, it had been nourished by him with the Hunyuan Tao Yun. Its power far exceeded that of the same level. Now it happened to be given to the three demons for self-defense.
Jiang Chen waved his hand and three acquired spiritual treasures floated in front of the three demons: "These three treasures will give you self-defense. Now follow your senior brothers to practice. I will break through to Daluo within five hundred years."
"Yes, Master."
Several people retreated in response, not daring to refute Jiang Chen's words.
After leaving the main hall, Yang Li couldn't help but asked Hong Hai'er: "Senior brother, is it a bit strange for our qualified master to ask us to break through to Daluo within five hundred years..."
Hong Hai'er answered with a smile: "It's a bit overwhelming, isn't it?"
"Exactly."
"Master is a powerful person in Hunyuan Daluo. How can his methods be beyond your imagination?"
"To tell you the truth, Master Gonggong created a small world with supreme magical power. The small world has sufficient spiritual energy and is not suppressed by heaven. The speed of time is only tens of thousands of times that in the ancient times. In five hundred years, becoming a Daluo is as simple as eating and drinking water."
